description: A straight, north–south–oriented pair of low-relief linear ridges flanking a shallow channel, ~250 m long and <1 m relief. Morphology and spacing (~10–15 m apart) match small-scale ditch–embankment water‐management features documented elsewhere in interfluves.
A near-rectangular enclosure (~120 m×80 m), with faintly elevated banks on the east and west sides and a slight inward basin, suggestive of a raised‐field plot or small reservoir.
A short, east–west terrace (~100 m long) set into a micro‐valley saddle, relief <0.5 m, aligned with anomaly_1 and likely part of the same canal network.
